tips.ai_analysis: Why it was picked: Harmonic just posted a strong Q3, with revenue up 64% and Q4 guidance above estimates, and heavy trading volume points to post-earnings drift. The research favored the optimist in both reads, and it sits outside the crowded semiconductor selloff, though part of the news may already be priced in. Research summary: HLIT posted a strong Q3, with revenue up 64% year over year to $148.8 million and non-GAAP EPS of $0.23 against $0.07 a year earlier, and Q4 guidance came in above estimates. The stock gapped up on Nov 4 from a $10.19 close to an $11.89 open, so much of the news may already be priced in. No company event is dated inside the window, which leaves post-earnings drift, analyst target cuts, and supply-cost worries as the main drivers. Not investment advice.
